author: Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Hans von Mžik
relations.evidence: Studied at Vienna law, soon Oriental languages, history and geography. Ph.D. 1904.

relations.subject: Hans von Mžik
relations.evidence: From 1903 worked in Vienna Hofbibliothek (then National Library).

relations.subject: Hans von Mžik
relations.evidence: PD 1917 Vienna “für historische Geographie des Orients”.

relations.subject: Hans von Mžik
relations.evidence: From 1921 also head of the map collection of Austrian National Library. After Anschluss his wife’s Jewish background became problem and in 1938 he was forced to retire from both university and library.

relations.subject: Hans von Mžik
relations.evidence: Ao. Professor 1929, from 1935 also taught Armenian. ... in 1938 he was forced to retire from both university and library.
